1 Melchizedek
https://othergospels.com/melchizedek/
Melchizedek's Judgement in the Year of Jubilee
1. And regarding what he said: ““In [this] year of jubilee, [you shall return, every man, to his property,]” ‒ ” [he said concerning this:] ““[Th]is is [the manner of the release]: every creditor shall release what he lent [to his neighbor; he shall not demand it of his neighbor or his brother, because it has been proclaimed], a release from G[od.]” ‒ ”
2. [The interpretation of this] for the last days applies to the captives, as [Isaiah said:] “[“To proclaim the release to the captives,”] ‒ ” and to their teachers who have been concealed and kept covert, and to the heritage of Melchizedek, fo[r ...], who will cause them to return to what is theirs.
3. And the release will be declared for them, in order to release them from [the debt of] all their sins.
4. And this [wil]l [come to pass] in the first week of the jubilee following the ni[ne] jubilees.
5. And the D[ay of Aton]ement will come after the e[nd of] the tenth [ju]bilee, when atonement shall be accomplished for all the sons of [light, and] for the men [who are] chosen for Mel[chi]zedek.
6. [...] upon [the]m [...] in accor[d with] a[ll] their [dee]ds, because it is the time for the ““year of (the) favor” ‒ ” of Melchizedek.
7. And by [his] power, he w[i]ll judge the saints of God, and in this way set up a just ki[n]gdom, as is written concerning him in the Songs of David, who said: ““God will [st]and in the assem[bly of God,] among the gods he judges.” ‒ ”
8. Also concerning him he sai[d]: ““[And] above [it,] in the highest heights, be seated: God will judge the peoples.” ‒ ”
9. Concerning what he sa[id]: ““[How long will you] judge unjustly and show fav[or] to the wicked? [Se]lah.” ‒ ”
10. Its interpretation applies to Belial and the spirits chosen for him, wh[o have all rebel]led, turn[ing away] from the statutes of God in order to [become wicked.]
11. Melchizedek will therefore execute the retribution of Go[d’s] judgments.
12. [And on that day he will real]ea[se them from the hand of] Belial, and from the hand of all the sp[irits chosen for him].
13. For his assistance there shall be all “the gods of [justice”; and h]e will be the one w[ho ...] all the sons of God, and [...].
14. This vi[sitation] is the day of [peace concerning whi]ch he ordered [... through Isa]iah the prophet, who said: “[“How] beautiful upon the mountains are the feet [of] the messen[ger who] announces peace, who brings ne[ws, who announces salvati]on, [sa]ying to Zion: your God [reigns.”] ‒ ”
15. Its interpretation: “The mountains” [are] the prophet[s], th[ose sent to declare the truth of God and to] proph[esy] to all of I[srael].
16. And the messenger i[s] the anointed of the spir[it], as Dan[iel] said [concerning him]: ““[Until an anointed one shall be cut off, it will be sixty-two weeks.”] ‒ ”
17. [And “the messenger of] news who announ[ces salvation]” is the one concerning whom it is written: “[“to proclaim the year of the Lord’s favor, the day of retribution of our God;] to comfo[rt] the [mourners].” ‒ ”
18. [Its interpretation:] to teach them in all the ages of the wo[rld ... and in the statutes] of [the] truth [...].
19. [... rule] that will pass from Belial and will re[turn to the sons of light ...].
20. [...] with the judgmen[t of] God, as is written concerning him: “[“who says to Zi]on: your God rules.” ‒ ”
21. [“Zi]on” i[s] [the assembly of all the sons of justice, those] who maintain the covenant, who refuse to walk [on the pa]th of the people.
22. And “your God” is [Melchizedek, who will relea]s[e them from the ha]nd of Belial.
23. And concerning what he said: ““You shall blow the hor[n aloud in] all the [l]and of [...].” ‒ ”
24. [...] and know [...] God [...].
25. [...] and many [...].
26. [...] the law [fo]r them [...] and he will announce [...].
27. [... t]he[y] shall consume Belial with fire [...]
28. [... of] Belial shall fight [...] with scheme[s] in their hearts [...] it i[s ...].
29. [...] the fortification[s] of Judah and [...] the fortification of Jer[usalem ...] a wall, and to raise up a column and [...].
30. [...] at its chosen time [...].
31. [...] the end of the Ju[bilee ...].
32. [... he] will carry it [...] two hundred [...] in those [...].
33. [...] the week [...] [the allot]ments of [the times ...].
